description: Pipe run along a polyline (input 0; without one, a default run that turns and rises): corners rounded into elbows of bend_radius, flanges at both ends and every flange_spacing metres, and floor stands under horizontal stretches. Pivot = the curve (the default run starts at the origin, 0.5 m up). Pieces: pipe (pipe_paint), pipe_flanges (steel), pipe_supports (metal_dark). Every piece is closed.

bend_radius.desc: elbow radius at the corners (m); 0 = mitred corners

flange_spacing.desc: distance between flange joints (m); 0 = only at the ends

supports.desc: stands from y = 0 under horizontal stretches

fillet.note: replace every corner by a circular arc tangent to both segments (radius clamped to half the shorter segment)

stands.note: keep points on near-horizontal stretches above the floor; drop them to y = 0 with the stand height as scale

params.code: const t = v@tangent; const top = @P.y - radius; if (Math.abs(t.y) > 0.3 || top < 0.05) { removepoint(0, @ptnum); return; } v@scale = [radius * 1.2, top, radius * 1.2]; p@orient = [0, 0, 0, 1]; @P.y = 0;

params.names: scale orient copynum curveu tangent N up curve_id
